lessons.title: Non-Fiction: Life in a Rock Pool
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to retrieve facts about rock pool creatures from a non-fiction text.
success_criteria: I can find a fact about a rock pool creature.
I can answer a question using the text.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what children think lives in a rock pool.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model reading a simple non-fiction text about rock pool creatures.
lessons.independent_task: Children read an extract and answer retrieval questions about rock pool life.
key_questions: What lives in a rock pool?
Where did you find that fact?

differentiation.greater_depth: Answer in full sentences using text evidence

lessons.assessment_notes: Note non-fiction retrieval skill — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.plenary: Recap facts found about rock pools.
lessons.home_link: Find a fact about the seaside at home.

lessons.title: Counting Rock Pool Creatures
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to count sets of rock pool creatures to 20.
success_criteria: I can count rock pool creatures.
I can write the numeral.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model counting rock pool creature counters into sets, recording numerals.
lessons.independent_task: Children count sets of rock pool creature counters up to 20, recording numerals.
key_questions: How many creatures in this set?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record counting accuracy consolidation — evidence for MATHS.N1.
lessons.plenary: Class total rock pool creature count.
lessons.home_link: Count shells or seaside objects at home.

lessons.title: What Lives in a Rock Pool?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to name creatures found in a rock pool.
success_criteria: I can name a rock pool creature.
I can describe one feature of it.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at pictures of rock pool creatures.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Introduce rock pool creatures (crabs, starfish, anemones, small fish) and their features.
lessons.independent_task: Children label a rock pool scene with creatures they've learned about.

differentiation.greater_depth: Add extra detail about each creature

lessons.assessment_notes: Note vocabulary and identification skill — evidence for SCI.ANI.
lessons.home_link: Look up a rock pool creature together.

lessons.title: Writing About a Rock Pool Creature
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write factual sentences about a rock pool creature.
success_criteria: I can write a fact about a rock pool creature.
I can use a capital letter and full stop.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap rock pool creatures from Monday.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a factual sentence about a rock pool creature.
lessons.independent_task: Children write 2-3 factual sentences about a chosen rock pool creature.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note factual writing progress — evidence for ENG.W2/W3.
lessons.plenary: Share rock pool creature fact sentences.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family a fact about a rock pool creature.

lessons.title: Comparing Sizes of Rock Pool Creatures
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to compare and order rock pool creatures by size.
success_criteria: I can say which creature is bigger.
I can order 3 creatures by size.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model comparing sizes of rock pool creature pictures.
lessons.independent_task: Children order rock pool creature picture cards from smallest to biggest.
resources_needed: Rock pool creature picture cards of varying sizes

differentiation.greater_depth: Order 5+ creatures and measure with cubes

lessons.assessment_notes: Note size comparison and ordering skill consolidation — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Compare sizes of toys or objects at home.

lessons.title: How Do Rock Pool Creatures Stay Safe?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how a rock pool creature protects itself.
success_criteria: I can name a way a creature protects itself.
I can name the creature.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss how a crab might protect itself.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss protection methods of rock pool creatures (shells, camouflage, pincers).
lessons.independent_task: Children match rock pool creatures to their protection method, recording their matching.
resources_needed: Creature and protection method picture cards
key_questions: How does this creature protect itself?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note understanding of animal protection/adaptation — evidence for SCI.ANI.
lessons.home_link: Talk about how an animal you know protects itself.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Rock Pool Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read rock pool-themed words.
success_criteria: I can blend and read rock pool words.
I can read a sentence about rock pools.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Introduce/reinforce a grapheme, blending rock pool-themed words (e.g. 'crab', 'rock', 'pool').
lessons.independent_task: Children read rock pool-themed word and sentence cards.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics application — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading rock pool words over the week.

lessons.title: Rock Pool Data: Tally and Pictogram
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to record and represent rock pool survey data.
success_criteria: I can record a tally.
I can make a pictogram.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap tally charts and pictograms from Week 21.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model conducting a survey of favourite rock pool creature, recording with tally and pictogram.
lessons.independent_task: Children help conduct and represent the survey, answering simple questions about it.

differentiation.support: Adult supports tallying and pictogram construction

lessons.assessment_notes: Record data handling consolidation — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Do a simple survey with your family.

lessons.title: Rock Pools: A Special Habitat
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe why a rock pool is a good habitat for its creatures.
success_criteria: I can say what a rock pool provides.
I can name a creature that benefits.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the concept of habitat from Week 21/23.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss what a rock pool provides for its creatures (shelter, food, water at low tide).
lessons.independent_task: Children explain why a rock pool suits a chosen creature, recording their reasoning.
key_questions: What does the rock pool give this creature?
Why is it a good home?

differentiation.greater_depth: Explain in detail with multiple reasons

lessons.assessment_notes: Note habitat suitability understanding — evidence for SCI.ANI.
lessons.plenary: Recap why rock pools are good habitats.
lessons.home_link: Talk about why your home suits your family's needs, drawing a simple parallel.

lessons.title: Rock Pool Explorer Role-Play
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe a rock pool discovery in role as an explorer.
success_criteria: I can describe what I 'found'.
I can answer a question about it.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model describing a rock pool 'discovery' in role as an explorer.
lessons.independent_task: Children take turns describing an imagined rock pool discovery to a partner, answering a question.
resources_needed: Rock pool creature picture cards for prompts
key_questions: What did you find in the rock pool?

differentiation.greater_depth: Describe unprompted with confidence and detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language and imaginative description skill — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.home_link: Describe an imagined rock pool discovery to your family.

lessons.title: Rock Pool Word Problems
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to solve addition/subtraction word problems using a rock pool context.
success_criteria: I can solve an addition problem.
I can solve a subtraction problem.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model solving word problems using a rock pool context (e.g. crabs scuttling in/out).
lessons.independent_task: Children solve rock pool-themed word problems, showing working.
lessons.assessment_notes: Record word problem solving skill — evidence for MATHS.N2.
lessons.home_link: Make up a rock pool word problem for your family.

lessons.title: Being a Responsible Rock Pool Explorer
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how to explore rock pools safely and responsibly.
success_criteria: I can name a rock pool safety rule.
I can say why it matters.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss why we should be careful exploring nature.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss rock pool safety and being gentle with creatures (looking not taking, being careful of tides).
lessons.independent_task: Children create a 'Rock Pool Explorer Rules' poster.
key_questions: Why should we be gentle with rock pool creatures?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's learning into environmental responsibility — evidence for SCI.ANI.
lessons.plenary: Display rock pool explorer rules posters.
lessons.home_link: Talk about being careful and respectful in nature.

lessons.title: Rock Pools Quiz: Reading Comprehension
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer comprehension questions about rock pools and coastal life.
success_criteria: I can answer a retrieval question.
I can answer an inference question.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's rock pool learning.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a summary passage about rock pools, modelling retrieval and inference questions.
lessons.independent_task: Children answer a mix of retrieval and inference questions about the passage.
key_questions: What lives in a rock pool?
Why do we need to be careful exploring them?

differentiation.support: Answer retrieval questions with text pointing

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension progress — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on rock pool facts you learned.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Data and Word Problems
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply data handling and word problem skills learned this week.
success_criteria: I can read a tally/pictogram.
I can solve a word problem.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of data handling and word problems.
lessons.independent_task: Children rotate through 2 stations: data handling, word problems.
key_questions: How did you solve this problem?
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise week 34 maths observations for each child — evidence for MATHS.MEA/N2.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining both skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising word problems over the weekend.

lessons.title: Rock Pools Topic Recap and Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise key learning about rock pools and coastal life.
success_criteria: I can name a rock pool creature and how it survives.
I can name a way to explore safely.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap quiz format covering rock pool creatures, protection, habitat, and safety.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a review worksheet and contribute to a class 'Rock Pools and Coastal Life' display.
key_questions: What have we learned about rock pools?

differentiation.support: Word bank and picture support provided

lessons.assessment_notes: Note habitat and animal adaptation understanding progress — evidence for SCI.ANI.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate the week's rock pools learning.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about rock pools with your family.
